meta.title: Destinations
meta.description: Six cities we know well enough to be useful about.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.intro: Six cities. We do not add a seventh until someone on the team has lived in it through a bad month.

kyoto.name: Kyoto
kyoto.body: Kyoto rewards the slow walker. Stay north of Nijo and the mornings belong to the neighbourhood: shutters going up, the smell of roasting hojicha, schoolchildren cutting through the shrine grounds. Our two houses here are both machiya — narrow wooden townhouses built for merchants, restored with their courtyard gardens intact.
kyoto.heroAlt: A narrow lane of wooden machiya townhouses
kyoto.cardAlt: A paved path under autumn maples leading to a temple roof

lisbon.name: Lisbon
lisbon.tagline: Tiled façades and a river that changes colour
lisbon.body: Lisbon is a city of thresholds — you are always about to arrive somewhere. We keep two places on the eastern hills, where the tram noise thins out after ten and the Tagus turns pewter at dusk. Both are a short walk from a bakery that has been arguing about custard tarts since 1937.
lisbon.heroAlt: A yellow tram climbing a street between pale stone buildings
lisbon.cardAlt: Red-tiled rooftops falling away towards the river

marrakech.name: Marrakech
marrakech.tagline: Courtyards built to keep the afternoon out
marrakech.body: Everything in the medina is oriented inward. A blank ochre wall opens onto a courtyard with a fig tree and a fountain, and the temperature drops five degrees as you step through. Our riad sits on a quiet derb ten minutes from the souks — close enough to hear them, far enough to sleep.
marrakech.heroAlt: A covered souk alley hung with lamps and baskets
marrakech.cardAlt: Cones of spice stacked on painted drums at a market stall

reykjavik.name: Reykjavík
reykjavik.body: Reykjavík is small enough to cross on foot and strange enough that you keep stopping. In June the light never really goes; in February it arrives like an apology around eleven. Both our stays are built for weather — thick walls, deep windows, somewhere to leave wet boots.
reykjavik.heroAlt: Snow-covered rooftops with the sea and mountains beyond
reykjavik.cardAlt: A rainbow-painted street between low painted buildings

oaxaca.name: Oaxaca
oaxaca.tagline: Markets, mezcal, and a very good green
oaxaca.body: Oaxaca de Juárez is a market town that happens to be a city. Our house in Jalatlaco sits on a street painted every colour at once, five minutes from a mercado where the mole vendors will make you taste all seven before letting you choose.
oaxaca.heroAlt: Papel picado bunting strung above a narrow street of ochre walls
oaxaca.cardAlt: An ochre wall with a barred window and the shadow of a tree

hoi-an.name: Hội An
hoi-an.tagline: A river town that glows after dark
hoi-an.body: Hội An was a trading port for four hundred years and still moves at a river's pace. Our boathouse is on the Thu Bồn, past the lantern crowds, where fishermen work the channel at first light.
hoi-an.heroAlt: A covered wooden bridge reflected in still canal water
hoi-an.cardAlt: Rows of silk lanterns glowing at dusk

stays.title: Stays

labels.enquireNote: Nothing on this site is bookable. The button goes to the booking page, where the terms live.

machiya-nishijin.name: The Nishijin Machiya
machiya-nishijin.tagline: Two floors, one courtyard, no hurry
machiya-nishijin.body: A restored weaver's house in Nishijin with the original lattice front and a garden you can see from the bath.
machiya-nishijin.heroAlt: A tatami room with a low table and floor chairs
machiya-nishijin.detailAlt: A round window framing the garden from a tatami room

kamo-riverhouse.name: Kamo Riverhouse
kamo-riverhouse.tagline: Above the water, below the crowds
kamo-riverhouse.body: A first-floor flat facing the Kamo, where the herons work the shallows all morning.
kamo-riverhouse.heroAlt: A dark timber room opening onto trees and water through a wall of glass
kamo-riverhouse.detailAlt: Wooden houses reflected in the river at sunset

alfama-atelier.name: Alfama Atelier
alfama-atelier.tagline: A painter's studio with the light still in it
alfama-atelier.body: Top-floor rooms in Alfama with north windows, a small terrace, and eighty-one steps.
alfama-atelier.heroAlt: A white bedroom with a straw hat and sunglasses left on the bed
alfama-atelier.detailAlt: The blue-tiled façade and iron balconies of the building

graca-rooftop.name: Graça Rooftop
graca-rooftop.tagline: The whole city, from a folding chair
graca-rooftop.body: A one-bedroom with roof access and the best cheap view in Lisbon.
graca-rooftop.heroAlt: Tiled rooftops and a church dome above the river
graca-rooftop.detailAlt: Pastel buildings stacked up the hillside under a cloudy sky

riad-zitoun.name: Riad Zitoun
riad-zitoun.tagline: Four rooms around a fig tree
riad-zitoun.body: A small riad on a quiet derb, with a plunge pool that is exactly cold enough.
riad-zitoun.heroAlt: A riad courtyard seen from below, with arched windows and iron screens
riad-zitoun.detailAlt: Tiled arcades running round the courtyard

palmeraie-annex.name: Palmeraie Annex
palmeraie-annex.body: A two-bedroom annex in the palm groves, twenty minutes and a world from the medina.
palmeraie-annex.heroAlt: A lawn and a walled pool with loungers under palm trees
palmeraie-annex.detailAlt: The pool and the palm trees behind the annex

reykjavik-turf-house.name: Turf House No. 4
reykjavik-turf-house.body: A modern take on a turf house, ten minutes from the harbour, built for February.
reykjavik-turf-house.heroAlt: A small turf-roofed house set into a grass bank near the shore
reykjavik-turf-house.detailAlt: Three black turf-roofed houses in a row

seltjarnarnes-cabin.name: Seltjarnarnes Cabin
seltjarnarnes-cabin.body: A cabin at the edge of the city with a clear northern horizon.
seltjarnarnes-cabin.heroAlt: A timber-lined room with a black wood stove and strung lights
seltjarnarnes-cabin.detailAlt: The wood stove and the window over the bay

casa-jalatlaco.name: Casa Jalatlaco
casa-jalatlaco.tagline: A courtyard house on a painted street
casa-jalatlaco.body: Three bedrooms around a courtyard, five minutes' walk from the mercado.
casa-jalatlaco.heroAlt: A long stone arcade of arches along a quiet plaza
casa-jalatlaco.detailAlt: A tree against the pink wall of the house

sierra-norte-lodge.name: Sierra Norte Lodge
sierra-norte-lodge.tagline: Pine forest, thin air, good silence
sierra-norte-lodge.body: A lodge in the mountains north of the city, run with the local community.
sierra-norte-lodge.heroAlt: A timber shelter glimpsed through overhanging branches above the water
sierra-norte-lodge.detailAlt: The red roof of the lodge among the pines

thu-bon-boathouse.name: Thu Bồn Boathouse
thu-bon-boathouse.tagline: On the water, past the lanterns
thu-bon-boathouse.body: A boathouse on stilts upriver from the old town, with a jetty and two bicycles.
thu-bon-boathouse.heroAlt: An old wooden river boat moored at a muddy bank
thu-bon-boathouse.detailAlt: Two wooden boats tied up on the river

cam-thanh-garden.name: Cẩm Thanh Garden
cam-thanh-garden.body: A garden house in the water-coconut palms, fifteen minutes by bike from the beach.
cam-thanh-garden.heroAlt: A low white house behind a hedge and tall trees
cam-thanh-garden.detailAlt: The garden and the low houses behind it

meta.title: Booking
meta.description: How booking with Wanderlane works, and what the terms actually say.

booking.title: Booking
booking.intro: There is nothing to pay on this page — Wanderlane is a demonstration site. The copy below is the real point: these are the strings a property changes at four o'clock on a Friday.

choose.title: Choose your dates
choose.body: Minimum stay is two nights, three over a public holiday.

hold.title: We hold the house for 24 hours
hold.body: No card details are taken while a hold is in place.

confirm.title: Confirm with a deposit
confirm.body: A 20% deposit confirms the booking. The balance is due 14 days before arrival.

policy.title: Cancellation policy
policy.body: Cancel more than 14 days before arrival and the deposit is refunded in full. Inside 14 days we refund whatever we manage to re-let, and we will tell you either way within two working days.
policy.updated: This policy was last changed on 3 March 2026.

taxes.title: Taxes and local charges
taxes.body: Prices include VAT where it applies. City tourist tax is collected at the property and is not included in the price shown.

booking.note: Every string on this page lives in TextSetu. Change one, publish, and it updates here within about a minute — with no rebuild and no deploy.

quote.overCapacity: This house sleeps {count, plural, one {# guest} other {# guests}}. Ask us and we will find you a bigger one nearby.
quote.disclaimer: Indicative only. Nothing is reserved and no payment is taken — Wanderlane is a demonstration site. City tourist tax is collected at the property and is not included above.

meta.title: About
meta.description: Who Wanderlane is, and why this site exists.

about.title: About Wanderlane
about.body: Wanderlane is a fictional travel brand. It exists as a public, readable example of how to wire a real website to a translation management system without hacks — build-time catalogues, runtime updates over a CDN, and a language switcher driven by live data rather than a hardcoded array.

why.title: Why a travel brand?
why.body: Because it is the least forgiving case. Long-form destination prose, legally sensitive booking terms, plural rules in guest counts, right-to-left copy, and a business that genuinely cannot wait for a deploy to fix a policy sentence.

credits.title: Photography
credits.body: All photographs are used under the Unsplash and Pexels licences. Attribution below is voluntary.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: This form does not send anywhere — it is here so the form labels have somewhere to live.

form.name: Your name
form.note: We usually reply within one working day.

legal.note: The body of this document is markdown in the repository, deliberately outside the translation catalogue. A legal document is reviewed and versioned as a whole, not edited string by string.
